news.text: #Juve Changes: #Ekhator Plays As The Number 9#Omonia arrives (9 PM)In the Europa League, the ex Genoa makes his debut as a starter. #Spalletti wants to evaluate him: "Baldini thinks the world of him".[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#EKHATORTHE ACID TEST/ THE TEST OF THE 9 (Pun using a play on words in Italian)At 9 PM, #Juve-#Omonia#Spalletti launches the young strikerFirst start for the ex genoano, who is aiming to earn his spot in January. Lucio: "Jeff is a promising talent". A victory would bring the round of 16 closer, but heavy squad rotation is expected: on Sunday there is #Como. #Neto makes his debut in goal, #Conceição is back.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🇵🇹💸 #Varela, #Monza sets the price: valuation of around €35M, with 20% of the future transfer fee owed to #Benfica. The brianzolo club would like to keep him, but if faced with an important offer they could let him go, potentially also asking for a % on the resale. #Juventus, #Barcelona, #Arsenal, #Milan, #Napoli, #Tottenham and #Brighton are all after him.[Andrea Losapio - TuttoJuve via @juventusinsidernews]
I'm in GTA 6 but I stay humble

#Juventus are still interested in #AtleticoMadrid’s striker Aleksander #Sorloth, who has been also approached by #Valencia and #Trabzonspor. #Juve would like to sign the norvegian striker on loan or in a swap (#Atletico want to keep Jonathan #David on a permanent deal) #transfers[Nico Schira]
#Juventus, #Bournemouth and #Newcastle are monitoring #Lazio’s midfielder Kenneth #Taylor for the summer transfer window. In fact Lazio don’t want to sell him in January. #transfers[Nico Schira]

Beppe #Marotta: “#Inter after #Varela? We like him, but many other clubs are interested in him. He is a pleasant surprise of our league…”. The nerazzurri are monitoring him for the summer; whereas other clubs are ready to prepare offers already in January to try to snatch him away from #Monza.[Nico Schira]
The young midfielder Fallou #Dione (born in 2012) has signed for #Juventus. He will play for #Juve U15. Deal completed by the agent Max Grillo. #transfers[Nico Schira]

🇵🇹⁉️ Premier League interest in #Conceição continues: after summer approaches from #Liverpool and #ManchesterUnited, Mendes has offered him to #Newcastle for June. The deal could also facilitate the permanent signing of #Woltemade at a discount. For now, however, he does not want to think about the future: his desire is to stay in Turin and try to win.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
